prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent SpriteKit game UI banner ornament for RainShadow, a painterly isometric fantasy detective RPG.
Primary request: one original wide combat-start banner backing, no text, matching warm aged-brass and charcoal RainShadow interface. Front-facing flat orthographic UI graphic. Long horizontal dark charcoal leather inset with subtle worn texture, fine antique brass double-line frame, restrained engraved cornerwork, gently tapered pointed ends. A small circular brass medallion centered above the frame holds two simple crossed short swords in low relief. The large central inset must be plain, very dark and empty for live text overlay. No lettering anywhere.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024 transparent canvas; single banner centered, approximately 1400 pixels wide and 300 pixels tall including medallion, generous transparent space around it. Main text inset horizontally centered below medallion. Crisp silhouette, symmetric, clean alpha, no drop shadow beyond a narrow soft edge. Painterly hand-finished metal details readable at 600 pixels wide.
Color palette: tarnished warm bronze and old gold, muted parchment highlights, almost black brown/charcoal leather. No red panel, no blue neon, no bright bloom.
Constraints: original design; isolated asset on genuinely transparent background. No scene, characters, words, logos, watermark, mockup or surrounding interface. Do not reproduce Baldur's Gate artwork.
